# reports/

Financial + operational reporting: BS / IS / TB / cash flow, VAT returns, SARS e-filing, KPI dashboards, consolidations, custom reports, trend + ratio analysis. 55 files — widest module. (AFS notes live in `services/afs/`; this is the core surface the UI binds to.)

## Caller contract
Invoked by `withCompany`-wrapped API routes in `pages/api/accounting/reports/*`, `pages/api/accounting/vat/*`, `pages/api/accounting/sars/*`, `pages/api/accounting/kpi/*`. Every public function takes `companyId` first. Services are predominantly read-only over GL; VAT/SARS submission services write back (`vat_submissions`, `sars_efiling_logs`, etc.).

## Main function signatures
- `getBalanceSheet(companyId, asOfDate, opts?)` / `getIncomeStatement(companyId, periodStart, periodEnd, opts?)`.
- `getVATReturn(companyId, periodStart, periodEnd)` — VAT201 box breakdown from GL lines.
- `generateForecast(companyId, horizonWeeks, opts)` / `getHistoricalForChart(companyId, months=6)`.
- `getConsolidatedTrialBalance(parentCompanyId, periodEnd)`; `getGroupCompanies(companyId)`; `createCompanyRelationship(...)`.
- `getTemplates(companyId, userId) / saveTemplate(...) / runReport(companyId, templateId, params)`.
- `getKpiDashboard(companyId, period)`; `getKpiCharts(companyId, metric, range)`.

## Business rules
- All queries scope by `company_id`; trial-balance-derived reports filter both `je.company_id` AND `jl.company_id` (mig 329).
- VAT return uses GL journal lines tagged with `vat_code` + `vat_amount`; don't double-count by joining `customer_invoices` or `supplier_invoices`.
- Consolidation: eliminations scoped to parent company; intercompany balances removed via `intercompanyService` before roll-up.
- **Group listing must use `listGroupsForUser(userId)`, never `listGroups()`** — the latter is unscoped and returns every tenant's groups. `listGroupsForUser` admits a group when the caller belongs to a member company **OR** created it; the creator clause exists because a group created without a holding company has no members, and an INNER JOIN made it invisible to its own creator — permanently orphaned, only fixable by direct DB access. `createGroup` does auto-enrol a holding company as the first member, so the orphan only occurs when that optional field is left empty.
- Custom reports: `customReportRunner` compiles user-defined field defs into parameterised SQL — all params bound, no interpolation.
- **A bank account is a `gl_accounts` row with `account_subtype='bank'`, never a `bank_accounts` row.** `bank_transactions.bank_account_id` FKs to `gl_accounts(id)`; `bank_accounts` is vestigial metadata (0 rows in production). Cash = `SUM(bank_transactions.amount)` over active bank-subtype GL accounts.
- **Outstanding AR/AP is `total_amount - COALESCE(amount_paid,0)`.** There is no `balance_due` column on either invoice table. Always gate on the shared `AR_OPEN_STATUSES` / `AP_OPEN_STATUSES` from `@/lib/constants/invoiceStatuses` — `'partial'` is not a legal status on either table, and `supplier_invoices` has no `'overdue'`.
- Facade files (`sarsService`, `kpiService`) re-export; add logic to the split services.
- Date handling: pg returns `Date` objects from timestamp columns — all report formatters accept both `Date` and ISO string.

## Recent changes
- 2026-08-31: **`vatAllocationMismatchService.findVatAllocationMismatches(companyId, {from,to,limit})` — read-only sweep behind `/api/accounting/vat-allocation-mismatches`.** Lists allocated bank transactions on two grounds: the row's stored vat code differs from what its journal actually posted (`displayed_differs_from_journal` — 1,594 rows and R456,612.35 of VAT on one company, all invisible on the bank screen), and input tax was claimed against an account whose `default_vat_code` is 'none' (`input_vat_on_denied_account` — the s17(2)(a) exposure). 'standard' is asserted from the PRESENCE OF A VAT-ACCOUNT LINE, not `gl_journal_lines.vat_type`: the tax line is what reaches VAT201, and an unset vat_type on the contra line would hide a real claim. Nothing writes — correct a confirmed over-claim through `reverseJournalEntry` and re-allocate.
- 2026-08-16 (part 2): the whole group-setup surface was non-functional and is now repaired. Every UI call site sent **snake_case** bodies while every route action destructures **camelCase**: add-member / update-member / auto-generate-coa / auto-map / set-mapping all 400'd, create-group silently dropped `holdingCompanyId` (so a new group enrolled no member — the real cause of the orphan), remove-member never sent the required `group_id`, and two call sites used actions that do not exist (`add-account`, `update-account`) — `add-account` fell through to the default POST branch and **created a company group named after the GL account** while reporting success. Bodies are now built by `src/components/accounting/group/groupRequests.ts`, which BOTH the UI and `tests/unit/api/groupSetupRequestShapes.test.ts` use, so the test drives the same payload the UI sends. Unknown POST/PUT actions are now rejected instead of falling through. Frontend types stopped redeclaring the API shapes in snake_case and re-export the service types instead — that alone surfaced 26 compile errors that had been silent `undefined` reads.
- **Query params on this route are snake_case; JSON bodies are camelCase.** Not a style choice to tidy casually — the DELETE branches read `req.query.member_id` / `group_id`. `groupRequests.ts` encodes both conventions so a call site cannot confuse them.
